gpu_memory_sampler.scope: sum of device memory of the worker process tree (plus the SparkSubmit JVM parent), sampled during the timed action; a sampled peak can miss short transients

gpu_energy_counter.semantics: cumulative whole-board energy of this device since the driver was loaded; take the difference of two reads; update granularity is host-specific (see --probe-gpu-energy)

energy_scope.tags: every gpu_energy value carries scope_tag: the counter tag, or none when it has no value

session_idle_rule.windows: two, labelled before_warmups (after engine init, before the first warm-up) and after_last_trial; engine ready, no query running; each preceded by settle_seconds without load (no query, no cleanup barrier)
session_idle_rule.record: idle_windows[i]: settle and window UTC + CLOCK_MONOTONIC stamps, gpu_energy (the counter read just outside the window's stamps, tagged like every GPU energy value), energy_interval_seconds (between the midpoints of the two reads) and mean_power_w = delta_mj / 1000 / energy_interval_seconds; CPU energy is cut from power.csv at the window stamps

energy_window_rule.rule: per measured trial of a query: runs continue until the summed timed time of the window's runs reaches target_seconds or max_runs runs have been made; n = runs made; n = 1 when the first run takes target_seconds or longer; n depends only on elapsed time, so the trials of one query may differ in n
energy_window_rule.t_hat_source: QA only, does not set n: seconds of the query's warmup record (phase warmup, trial 0) in this session
energy_window_rule.record: one record per (query, measured, trial): seconds is the window time divided by n, rows and the plan are run 1's, timed_* span the window (gaps included), gpu_energy is replaced by energy_window (per-run stamps, counter reads and energy, window sums, per-run means). energy sums the runs' own counter differences, never end minus start
energy_window_rule.cleanup: the query-cleanup barrier runs after every run as in Paper 1 and is outside the window energy; the barrier after run n is in cleanup_records, the ones after runs 1..n-1 in window_cleanup_records
energy_window_rule.output_check: run 1: rows stored, compared with the polars reference by preflight (G2). Runs 2..n: compared in this process with run 1's rows (ints exact, floats rel 1e-8 / abs 1e-6, the G2 rule); verdict and row count stored, rows stored only for a run that disagrees

timing_clock.monotonic: time.monotonic_ns(): CLOCK_MONOTONIC, shared with the runner's host.csv and power.csv monotonic_ns
timing_clock.boundary: timed_start_* are read just before the perf_counter timer starts and timed_end_* just after it stops, so [timed_start, timed_end] contains the timed region by a few microseconds; seconds is unchanged
